linked_prs.title: fix: qdrant with ingest not working

ai_judgment.response: Yes. The issue involves a memory-related problem with the Qdrant component, specifically the failure to initialize or configure the embedding parameter required for `VectorStore.from_documents()`. This aligns with memory initialization issues in agent systems as described in the taxonomy.
